title: A Songbook for the Postcard
author: Coral Coldharbour
blurb: Rosalind Sandoval, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the bakery lease runs out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
